<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sites"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every Site on the warehouse map, ordered by site code, including sites that have been decommissioned (their status says so). This is a read model over the Site repository; it performs no writes and publishes no events. Keyset-paginated: `limit` and `cursor`; follow `nextCursor` until it is absent.
